Oliver: ops knobs: enable KV warmstart to recover ~40ms tail; 20ms batching recovers ~30ms p95 at ~2% throughput loss.

Ciara: recommend ops guards: 0.5% shadow then 1% live canary; rollback if factuality 94 <= -5% over 12h or p95 > +100ms.

Maya: I'll craft the one-paragraph rec + 3-metric card (cost delta, helpfulness 94, factuality 94) and attach raw CSV. thanks all :thumbsup:
